searchText: I would like a refund for selfdestruct, this is the smallest possible change that can be made: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12249 Replied to this here: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1540737956929736766/1542792682433413140 Fix to the spec where it diverged from the actual implementations. I assume the implementation is right here, the spec looks like unimplementable. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12256 Moreover, I'm not sure the frame-level LIFO is actually well designed or just accidental. Do you have any data to back it up?
